method_statement: What exists here is a finite set of executable checks over concrete inputs: Gleam test modules exercising typed specification functions, plus digest comparisons I performed. These establish that the named properties held FOR THE CASES RUN. They do not establish universal refinement, and no theorem prover, model checker or SMT solver was invoked by anyone in this activation. No solver run is claimed or implied.
what_is_NOT_claimed: No universal quantification over inputs. A passing finite suite is not a proof.
No theorem proving. Lean, Rocq, Z3, Quint and TLA+ were NOT run; theorem_proving is NOT_RUN and that is a statement of fact, not a deferral.
No refinement proof between the specification functions and their callers.
No admission of any kind, and no production or Telegram capability.
No claim that the six modules collectively cover the invariant space of development.gleam.
